correctness.rationale: PASS: Local boundary mass M_K(r)≤2πr for full planar convex bodies follows from convex intersection/perimeter monotonicity, and for segments double length ≤4r<2πr. Support parametrization x=h n+h'τ, ds=(h+h'')dθ, integration by parts gives exact shape derivative ∫v(f+ρ∇f·n) and no tangential v' remainder. For p<0 flat truncation f_eps=min(|x|^p,eps^p) bounds gradient ∫|∇f_eps|≤2π(1−p)eps^p, singular remainder ≤2π(-p)/(p+1)eps^(p+1), choose eps=δ. For p≥0 use bound ∫p|x|^(p−1) and radius R, yielding stated Lipschitz coefficients. Weak boundary measure limit and uniform cutoff extend to segments/points. Point vs small disk makes exponent p+1 optimal, concentric disks fixed radius force exponent≤1 for p>0. Finite CHECKS.py verifies selected disks/segments/triangles but cannot prove universal statement.
